Seeing this Sandakan bowled it wide outside off. Such is Haque's flow today, that he reaches out to that and hits it inside out over covers for a boundary. This is the fourth time he has converted a 50-plus score to a triple figure at this venue. Excellent. He raises his helmet and his bat to acknowledge all the applause that he is receiving. He will know, however, that the job is yet not completely over.
FOUR! Mominul moves to 97 with an authoritative shot. Flatter in trajectory, he gets down and blasts it over mid on for a boundary.
This ball is outside off, pushed to point.
Sandakan starts off with a ball outside off that is on a shortish length. Rahim goes back and cuts it to deep point for one.
Double change. Lakshan Sandakan is brought back for a spell before Tea.
Flatter on the stumps, pulled off the inner half through square leg for a brace.
Slower in pace, on off. Haque lets it come on and blocks it.
Flatter on the stumps, defended with a straight bat.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
Similar delivery, defended with a prod forward.
Floated on the stumps, lofted over mid-wicket for a couple.
Dhananjaya de Silva to roll his arm over.

FOUR! Classic. As easy as they come. Full and outside off, Rahim gets his stride forward and drives it through covers. Such is the timing on that, that it races away to the fence. It is a mere push but it still has enough to go to the fence.
Fuller on the stumps, stonewalled from the crease.
Short in length, pulled away through square leg for one.
Another one outside off, Haque lets it be.
Length delivery on the stumps, blocked from the crease.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Haque comes down the track and whips it through mid on for one.
Placed towards point for one.

Sri Lanka are not helping themselves with such lousy efforts on the field. Flatter outside off, cut away towards point. Should have been just one but the fielder there doesn't get down in time and lets it through. Three runs come off that delivery as a result, which RAISES THE 100-RUN PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN HAQUE AND RAHIM. This has been a fluid association between the two as it has come off just 126 balls.
Fuller in length, in line of the stumps, Haque gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Perera seems to be tiring. He drops another one short in length, with the flight almost being absent. Mominul is too set to miss out on these. He goes back and slaps it through covers and helps himself to a boundary. He moves to 82 from 80.
Full on the stumps, defended from the crease.
Another very full ball on off, hit to the man stationed at mid off.
Fuller on off, Rahim drives it on the up to mid off.
This ball is sprayed down the leg side, Rahim fails in his attempt to flick.
Shorter outside off, cut away through cover-point for one.
Angling in on the pads, turned through square on the leg side for one.
Lahiru Kumara is back on. He has been expensive so far, with an economy rate of over 6.
Shorter in length, cut away straight to point.
Shortish in length again, Rahim plays it past slip for one.

Sri Lanka's spinners have been a touch short on this surface in the game so far. That allows the batsmen ample time to go back and play the ball. Rahim goes back to this one and guides it past the slip fielder. Before the ball is returned a brace results. However, the throw from the deep hits the stumps at the batter's end but Rahim is well in.
Fuller around leg, Mominul charges down and eases it to mid off for one.
Flatter on the pads, Haque fails to flick it. The ball lobs to the right of the short leg fielder for nothing.
Floated around off, turned through mid-wicket for one.
Lakmal steams in round the wicket and bowls it outside off. Haque plays it towards point where the fielder stops it with a dive.
Short in length, pulled through backward square leg for one.
Banged short in line of the stumps, Rahim lets it be.

Nice point. Herath has gone at 5 runs an over in this innings so far. This is not the case in helpful conditions generally with the wily old spinner. Roshan Abeysinghe on air states that the Bangladeshi batters have countered him by making use of their feet, by making use of the sweep and cut shots to good effect. This has caught the veteran off guard and hence he has been ineffective so far.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, driven to covers.
Fuller around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Fuller on the pads, Haque fails to flick it away and gets hit on the pads.
Floated on the stumps, eased through mid on for one.

Rahim fails to cash in on a rubbish ball. Perera darts it on a shorter length, the pace is not much as well. Mushfiq goes back to pull but due to the lack of pace, he is into the shot at 4pm while the ball comes to him at 5pm. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads and it rolls towards short leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Around off, pushed towards the bowler.
Floated outside off, driven to mid on.
Short in length, pulled to fine leg for one.
Another bouncer, Mushfiqur ducks yet again but his bat is left hanging up like a periscope.
FOUR! Clever. Length ball outside off at 133.5 kph, it nips in a touch. Rahim stays back and guides it to the third man fence for a boundary. 200 up for Bangladesh.
Karunaratne moves to short mid-wicket now from the off side.
Fuller around off, defended towards covers.
Bouncer around off, Rahim ducks with his bat pointing skywards. Not the best of techniques as the ball can easily strike the bat and lob to a fielder.
Hurled in line of the stumps, Rahim stands back and blocks it.
Drinks!
Around middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed back to the bowler.
Cuts it off the keeper's gloves and past the man at first slip for a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven a bit squarer on the off side for two more.

Down the leg side, clipped off the pads to fine leg. They want the third one and get it easily in the end. Good running. No ball called! The reason is the short leg fielder moved to his left and that made him the third fielder behind square on the leg side, in addition to deep backward square leg and fine leg. According to the rule, a maximum of two fielders can be placed behind square on the leg side. Good umpiring from the square leg umpire. It's Rod Tucker.
Good length delivery, angling in, Mushfiqur hangs back in defense.
Chandimal is off the field and Akila Dananjaya is on the field as a substitute.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller again on off, driven again towards cover.
Nicely presses forward to a full ball and drives it straight to the man at cover.
Shortish on leg stump, tucked towards square leg.
A bit too straight and on the pads, Haque flicks it neatly through mid-wicket. Two men give it a chase and through some tag team effort, they manage to keep them down to two.
Loopy ball outside off, Mushi prods forward in defense.
Dipping in, wristed towards the mid on fielder.
Taps it towards point and calls through for a single.
Around leg, worked towards the leg side.

FOUR! Played it really late! Pushes it through the air, a bit short and outside off. Mominul goes deep in the crease and decides to use the pace on the ball. Dabs it late towards third man. Kumara goes sprinting to his right, looks to dive but his knee gets stuck on the turf as he tries to do that. The ball wins the race.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Haque goes back to flick but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed towards the man at cover. A maiden to start this spell.
Angles this one into the pads, clipped towards square leg.
Pitches it up, just outside off, bunted into the cover region.
Covers the line and defends it down off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
Once again hangs back to a similar length delivery and stabs it out.
Comes steaming in from over the wicket and drops it on a back of a length outside off, Rahim offers a compact defense.
The pacer comes on. It will be Suranga Lakmal to have a go with the ball.
Once again slows it through the air, outside off, Rahim taps it in front of point for a quick single.
Slows it through the air, at 77.5 kph, angles it in as Rahim goes back to keep it out on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lunges forward and defends it right under his eyeline.
FOUR! Another cracking shot! Herath fires it full outside off, Rahim stays leg side and drills it. Perera at deep cover dives but fails to stop it from crossing the fence.
Covers the line and defends it down safely.
A bit flat on the stumps, punched back to Perera who parries it towards mid on and they run one.
Tossed up around leg, nudged with soft hands towards short mid-wicket.
Bunted back to the bowler off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets forward to a tossed ball and flicks it towards the leg side.
Slider outside off, Mushfiqur stays deep in the crease, dabbed fine towards third man for a couple of runs.

This time it's Rahim who looks to attack. Comes dancing down to a tossed up ball, isn't quite to the pitch of the ball but still has enough to clear the man at mid off. Sandakan stops it just inside the rope but can't prevent the batsmen from running three. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two as well.
Goes back and with the turn, Rahim works it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and leg, driven towards deepish mid on for a single.
FOUR! Mominul Haque is having some fun out there! Herath flights this up outside off, Haque skips down the track and goes bang over extra cover. Superbly done!
Flighted ball outside off, driven towards mid off the front foot.
Goes back and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Eases this towards the mid off fielder.
Mid on drops back a bit.
FOUR! Good use of the feet again! Floated delivery, dipping in, Mominul Haque dances down the track and lofts it over mid on. Couple of bounces and into the fence she goes.
Poor ball! Fuller on leg stumps, swept on the full to Sandakan at fine leg for just a single.
Hangs back to this one and defends it from within the crease.
Comes from around the wicket and starts off with a flighted ball outside off, defended towards the cover fielder.
Dilruwan Perera to replace Sandakan.
Darted on the pads, flicked towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Fuller but down the leg side, swept towards fine leg for an easy peasy brace.

FOUR! Good hit to bring up the 13th Test fifty. Well played, Mominul Haque! He is doing what Tamim did in the morning. Dictating the terms in a classic manner. In just 59 balls, he has got to the milestone, ominous signs for Sri Lanka. Gets down to a tossed up delivery and whips it uppishly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Pushes it quicker through the air, punched off the back foot.
Flighted ball around off, driven towards mid off for a quick single.
Goes back, opens the face of the bat and dabs it behind point for a single to end the over.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Quicker one outside off, chopped off the back foot in front of square on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Freebie and Haque makes the most of it! Sandakan isn't getting it right. He drops it short, it's wide outside off, slapped powerfully through backward point for a boundary.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Haque with a lunge forward, pushed it back to the bowler.
Drifting in on off, Mushfiqur presses forward to defend but gets an inside edge which rolls through his legs towards the leg gully fielder. A maiden from Herath. Good testing over!
Leans forward to a loopy ball and drives it into the off side.
Drifting in from around off, Rahim shows compact defense.
Goes back to the flatter one and blocks it out with a straight bat.
Some flight on this one, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Flatter and skidding a bit, Rahim sits deep in the crease to defend.
Another one down the leg side, this time the southpaw is happy to leave it alone.
Wide! Horrible delivery and Sandakan will be lucky to get away with that one! Short and spining down leg as it's the googly. Haque goes deep in the crease to pull but gets beaten.
Allows the ball to turn in and then clips it through square leg for a single.
Loopy leg break, turning away from outside off, Haque goes after it as he mistimes his punch through cover to get one more.
Goes back to this shorter one does Mushfiqur and cuts it through backward point for another single.
Flatter and turning away from off, slapped a bit square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Flighted delivery around off, MH presses forward in defense.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Lunges forward and bunts it back to the bowler.
Floated ball on the stumps, blocked.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Flighted delivery, landed too full outside off. Rahim leans forward a touch and caresses it through the cover region. It races away to the fence.
Around middle and leg, wristed away through the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mominul Haque makes room and drives it through the gap at cover. The man from mid off mops it up but they take two till then.
A bit of flight, Rahim keeps it out.
Tossed up around leg, broomed along the ground through backward square leg for one.
Stands back and pushes it towards the off side.
Flatter one outside off, crunched towards the point fielder.

FOUR! Hit with disdain! Lakshan drops it short, Mominul is quick to rock back and pull it over mid-wicket. It was the wrong one and the batsman read it well. Back-to-back boundaries for the southpaw. He's looking really good out there.
FOUR! What a shot! This shows how confident Mominul is! Sandakan gives it some air, lands it full outside off. Haque makes room and goes inside out over extra cover to pick up a one-bounce boundary.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg to keep strike.
Flighted ball around middle and off, MH comes down the track to bunt it back to Rangana.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Defended into the ground off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards cover.

Well, well! Imrul Kayes wasn't a dead duck! The Hawk Eye was just shown and it displayed that the ball would have gone over the stumps. Who should be blamed? Mominul? Because Kayes did confer with him whether to take the review or not and the no. 3 batsman told him not to. Now from his perspective, he was standing a bit wide at the other end and must have thought that it's hitting the stumps. Nonetheless, a lucky breakthrough for the Lankans.
Starts from around the wicket, tosses it up around middle and leg, Mominul comes down the track and works it past mid-wicket for a single.
Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end.
Rahim presses forward and defends it down safely.
Tossed up on off, blocked gently.

We are back for the middle session. Lakshan Sandakan struck on the last ball of the first session to push Bangladesh on the back foot. Has this given the visitors an opening? Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in and he will be facing the first ball. Let's play...
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Mominul Haque then walked in and continued the run-flow along with Kayes. They used their feet to good affect against the spinners but just towards the end when Sri Lanka managed to get one more over in, the hosts lost the latter. Sri Lanka will be happy by pulling things back and with the pitch having enough purchase for the spinners, it will be interesting to see if the home side still opts for the aggressive approach. Join us for the post-lunch session in a bit...

The wicket of Imrul Kayes makes this session an even one. Bangladesh were up and running after winning the toss and opting to bat. Tamim Iqbal, in particular was off the blocks in a jiffy and it seemed like he is in the mood today. He raced his way to a blazing fifty to make the Lankan bowlers look clueless. However, Dilruwan Perera then came in and with some smart piece of bowling, drew first blood by knocking Iqbal out.

OUT! Trapped in front! Both the Bangladesh openers are back in the hut! Sandakan strikes to end the first session on a high. Beautiful delivery, this! Bowls a googly, drops it outside off. Kayes prods forward in defense but this one turns back in to hit him flush on the pads adjacent to the stumps. Huge appeal follows to which the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. Imrul walks across to his partner and after discussing with him decides against taking the DRS and continues to walk back. Looked like a dead duck. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Flighted ball around off, driven towards cover for a single.
Haque dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Lunges forward to a full ball and blocks it out. Since one minute is left, we will have one more over in.
Haque comes down the track and bunts it back to the bowler.
Comes down the track to push it away but misses and wears it on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up around off, pushed towards mid off.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Dilruwan Perera has a change of ends. Could be the last over before lunch...
Tossed up around off, pushed towards cover.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! Easily in! Imrul Kayes shimmies down the track and pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a single. Lakmal charges to the ball, picks it up and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. They appeal and it's taken upstairs. Replays find Kayes has dragged his bat in, in time.
Direct hit and this could be interesting. Lakmal takes down the stumps at the bowler's end and a run out appeal is taken upstairs...
Goes back and pushes it towards point.
Flattish through the air around middle and off, blocked off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
We have a change in bowling. Lakshan Sandakan is brought into the attack.
Shortish again, Haque looks to pull but drags it off the bottom edge to square leg.
Hits the deck hard, gets some good bounce as Imrul sits under the bumper.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Rocks back to this short ball, maybe he anticipated this did Kayes. Pulls it wide of the man at mid on and takes three.
Short ball, angling away, it's not that short and could have been defended but Imrul ducks.

Short ball, gets a touch big on Mominul who still goes on with the pull shot. Gets it off the high portion of the bat towards mid-wicket. Dhanajaya de Silva comes running in but takes his eyes off and overruns but the batsman is happy with one.
Lunges forward again to defend it down into the ground. Maiden for Dilruwan, his second.
Very full on off, jammed out to the man at mid off.
Floated delivery outside off, Kayes defends it into the ground.
Gets forward and pushes this loopy ball towards cover.
Quicker and lands it full on off, blocked watchfully.
Fires it full on middle and off, Imrul presses forward in defense.
Wears it on the body! Shortish delivery, maybe it was the slower one. Haque shapes up for the pull but is early into the shot. The ball hits him on the left shoulder.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, the batsman hangs back in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pitches it right up there, worked straight to the man at mid on. The bat turned at the impact and that is why he got it off the inner half.

Huge appeal but to no avail! Fuller in length around leg, Mominul tries flicking it away but it's delivered at 138.8 kph. Gets beaten for pace and wears it on the pads. An appeal for LBW but it was pitching outside leg.

FOUR! Carved it away! Poor ball from Lahiru! Short but served wider outside off. It was asking to be put away and Haque does exactly that. Stands tall and slaps it over point for a boundary. The stand is worth 40 from 38 balls.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Nudges this full ball towards the leg side.

FOUR! Nailed it! Perera gives it a nice flight but the line is around middle and leg. Kayes sits down and unfurls a cracking sweep shot behind square on the leg side for a boundary to beat the man in the deep.
Flatter delivery on middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
Tosses it up around off, blocked watchfully.
Stifled appeal! Slider and it goes on with the arm, Kayes goes back to flick it away but misses to get hit on the pads. Perera appeals but then bails out as it was going down leg.
Hops a touch and wrists it away towards short mid-wicket for a dot to end the over.
Comes from around the wicket and bangs in a short one outside off. The little man gets on top of the bounce to cut that there isn't any width offered. Chops it straight to the backward point fielder.
Gets on top of the bounce to tuck this one away into the leg side for a single.
Slants it away on the shorter length, Mominul takes it from there as  he pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Stays back to this back of a length ball and tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Shortish length delivery on middle and leg, defended towards the vacant short leg region.

FOUR! That's a gift from Perera and Haque accepts it gleefully! A long hop from the offie to which Mominul rocks back and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket to find the fence. 100 up for Bangladesh!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the pads, MH moves inside the line and clips it down to fine leg for a double.

Loopy delivery outside off, Mominul Haque comes down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and hits it between mid off and extra cover. Lakmal from the former position gives it a chase to keep them down to a brace.
Very full and quicker through the air on middle and leg, Kayes bring his bat down to defend but the ball takes the inner half and rolls past the man at short leg. A single taken.
Pushes it through the air, at 91.3 kph, Kayes goes back to cut but ends up chopping it into the off side.
FOUR! Drilled! Kumara goes very full, it's outside off. Haque brings his bat down and hits it hard. Beats the dive of the cover fielder as the ball whistles away to the fence.
Hits the deck hard again but with not much venom behind. Easily dealt with.
Goes fuller, attacks the stumps, IK walks across and flicks it wide of mid on to get to the other end.

FOUR! Pierced the gap! Another one on the shorter length, angling in on the body. Kayes swivels a touch and help-pulls it. It's in the air but hit really well to bisect the two men in the deep - backward square leg and square leg. A boundary results!

Wide! We saw Kumara bending his back in his previous spell and does so again. The effort, however, was too much as this has been called as a wide. Digs in a short ball on off, it bounces too much as Imrul sits under it.
On a length and just outside off, defended down by getting behind the line.
Starts his new spell with a back of a length delivery, but it's on the hips. Easily tucked away in front of square on the leg side. A single picked up.
Lahiru Kumara is recalled into the attack.
Flighted delivery outside off, Mominul leans across and drives it nicely through the gap at cover. Some good running between the wickets allows them to collect a triple.
Is right behind the line and defends it down.
Drops it a touch short, it's served outside off, punched off the back foot to the cover fielder.
Tosses it up around middle and off, a nice forward defense on offer.
Pushes it through the air, Haque goes back and offers a straight blade.
Takes a long stride forward to defend but gets it off the inner half past short leg for a single.
Dances down the track, takes it on the full and whips it through mid-wicket to end the over with a brace.
Nearly chips one! Herath comes down the track and hence fires it full on leg. The batsman nearly chips this one towards short mid-wicket.
Dances down the track and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Mominul eases it towards the man at mid off.
Loopy ball outside off, driven past the cover fielder for one.
Very full outside off, jammed out through the gap at cover for a couple of runs.
Good way to end the over! Haque takes a stride forward and blocks it out. Wicket maiden for Dilruwan.
Mominul Haque walks in next.

OUT! Breaches the defense of Tamim! Dilruwan Perera with the breakthrough. Much-needed one as the veteran opener was looking dangerous here. Perera slides in an arm ball, it lands on middle and off as Tamim presses forward to defend. The ball skids off the surface, beats the defense on the inside and deflects off the pads to strike the timber. Superb delivery! Iqbal departs after a blazing start.
Comes down the track to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Pushes it down the leg side, the batsman lets it be.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Tamim Iqbal looks to cut but misses as the ball hits the pads of the keeper.
Flighted ball on the stumps, Iqbal looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
Imrul takes a stride forward and blocks it out.
Very full around middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for the fifth single of the over.
Nicely tossed up on the stumps, eased to mid on for a quick single.
Darted on the stumps, worked past short leg for a single.
A bit short on middle, pinched towards mid on for a single.

Fifty for Tamim Iqbal, his 25th in this format! It has come in just 46 balls. Played, Iqbal. Herath floats it up around leg, clipped past short leg for a single. Raises the bat and gets back to business. With the way he is off, seems like he will score a big one.

Drinks time! Bangladesh have done well to counter the initial phase of the game. They haven't been always commanding as edges have got them runs on more occasions than not. Tamim Iqbal is in the limited-overs mode and is taking the attack to the opposition at every opportunity that he finds. He has been fortunate to not edge one straight to the fielders. Sri Lanka haven't been all that bad with the ball as they have created chances but to no avail. The stand is worth 67. Can the visitors break it in this session?
Punched off the back foot through covers to move to 49 and retain strike.
Floated wide outside off, Tamim watches it go straight into the keeper's gloves.
This time the line is outside off, driven through covers for one.
On a flatter trajectory in line of the stumps, Kayes lunges forward and defends.
Outside off, Kayes gets it off the outer half towards backward point.
Served outside off, pushed through covers for one.
Floated full down the leg side, Tamim gets down to sweep but gets a glove. It goes through the keeper and he gets three. Moves to 47 and retains strike.
Floated outside off, Iqbal charges down the track and hits it to mid on.
Imrul drives it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Eased through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Another one around middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Begins from round the wicket and drops it in line of the stumps. Tamim defends it with a straight bat.

Rangana Herath is brought into the attack. In recent times under Chandimal's captaincy, we have seen that he goes to the wily old fox only when he feels that the others aren't getting him a breakthrough and that seems to be the case here. A slip and a short leg in place.
This ball is cut away to backward point.
Floated outside off, Imrul looks to guide it towards third man but does so off the outer edge past slip. Gets two for the same.

Interesting. There were two bouncers at Kayes that we have seen so far, on which he looked to be in a slight trouble. In the first instance, he got it high on the bat towards backward square leg and in the second, he got it towards fine leg. So the on-air commentators opine that this tactic could be an option against the southpaw.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Kayes goes back to this one and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flat and short outside off, Iqbal slaps it powerfully through covers for one.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
Eased through mid-wicket for one to retain strike. Tamim moves to 42, in a stand worth 56.
Full outside off, Iqbal hangs his bat out to defend but misses.

Another short ball aimed at the batsman's head, Kayes gets into a tangle. He fails to get out of the line and ends up getting it high on the bat towards fine leg for one. No ball signaled, not sure for what. Also, the umpire signals to Lakmal that it was the second bouncer for the over.
Bouncer on the stumps, Kayes gets out of the line by ducking under.
Length ball outside off, cut away straight to the point fielder.
On a length around middle and leg, Imrul hops and plays it to mid-wicket.
Kayes pushes this towards mid off for nothing.

Outside off, pushed towards mid off to rotate strike. 8 runs have come off this one. 53-0 at the end of 10 overs. Are we seeing an ODI here? Certainly the colours of the dress and the ball doesn't state so.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter ball on the stumps, turned to the on side for one.

SIX! Whooosh! That has disappeared out of the ground! Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Iqbal charges down the track quickly. Gets to the pitch of the ball and deposits it over long on for half a dozen. Brings up the 50 between these two and this is turning out to be a good start for the hosts. It is good to remember, that most of the boundaries have come off the edges, which means the tourists aren't bowling all that bad.
Flatter on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated just outside off, Iqbal looks to come down by making room but has to adjust due to the width on that and bunt it down.
The first maiden over from Sri Lanka in the game. Full around off, Kayes pushes it towards covers.
Full on off, defended towards covers.
Length delivery, defended towards point.
This is outside off, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads, kept out towards square leg.

FOUR! Wow! Seeing the spinner bowl, Tamim decides to take him on straightaway. Tossed up in line of the stumps, Iqbal charges down making room and bashes it through wide mid off. Succeeds in finding the gap between mid off and covers as the ball speeds away to the fence.
Imrul pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Around middle and leg, flicked away to the on side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
Spin time. With the pacers going for runs in the first 7 overs, Chandimal looks towards spin and brings on Dilruwan Perera into the attack. A slip and a short leg in place.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Edged and safe, AGAIN! Full and outside off, on a driving length. Tamim goes for it with no feet movement. Gets a thick outside edge that goes between the diving keeper and first slip and races away to the fence. Fortunately for Iqbal, it didn't carry to either of them and hence results in runs.

Direct hit from Herath. Iqbal plays it wide of mid-wicket and sets across for the first run. Kayes makes it in to the striker's end despite a direct hit there. The ball then deflects towards fine leg and another run is taken.
Around middle and leg, Iqbal gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
Another outside edge. This time it goes to the third slip fielder on the bounce.
Full and in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Bumper on the stumps, Kayes ducks.
Outside off, left alone.
Around off and middle, defended from the crease.

FOUR! Oh dear! The Sri Lankan vice-captain has not helped his side with this effort. Kumara bangs it short in line of the off and middle stumps. Kayes goes for the pull but isn't in control. The ball goes high in the air towards deep backward square leg. Lakmal runs to his right from fine leg and almost gets to the ball, but strangely, he doesn't go for the catch. The ball bounces in front of him and he fails to keep it within the ropes as well. Kumara can do nothing but have his hands on his waist, seeing that.

FOUR! Tell you what, Sri Lanka haven't bowled all that bad yet Bangladesh have got off to a quick start here. Full in length, inviting the drive, Kayes cannot resist the temptation. Goes for it and gets a thick outside edge through the gap between gully and second slip for yet another boundary.
Length ball down the leg side, Kayes shoulders arms and lets it be.
Banged short in length in line of the stumps, Iqbal ducks under it.
Fuller and angling away, Iqbal looks to defend but gets it off the outer half towards backward point.
Bowled around off and slanting away, Iqbal looks to defend but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, defended from the crease.

FOUR! Fourth boundary for Tamim Iqbal and yet again, this isn't a commanding one. Length ball angling away from the batter, Tamim gets ahead to defend. Ends up getting this one off the outside edge and the ball races away through the gap between second slip and gully. It has enough on it to go to the fence, beating the slide from the fielder chasing it.
Length delivery outside off, Kayes stands tall and blocks it towards cover-point.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
Well outside off, left alone.
Fuller on off, defended with a small stride forward.
Careful, Imrul! On a length outside off, Kayes tries to cut it. The ball bounces a bit more and misses the outside edge by just.
Kumara comes round the wicket and bowls it outside off. Kayes minds his own business and lets it be.
Length ball outside off, punched through point for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full in length, blocked off the front foot.
This is outside off, left alone by Tamim.
Iqbal stands on the back foot and defends it.
Quick single! Kayes pushes this delivery to mid off and takes on Sandakan's arm. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There is intent shown from the hosts to score.
Hangs back to this ball on a length and defends it with a straight bat. 15 runs off this over and Bangladesh have a positive start here.
Angling away from the stumps, driven through covers for a brace. Iqbal is quickly on to 18 here.

FOUR! Three-in-three. This has been the best of the lot. Fuller in length around off, Tamim gets his stride forward and pushes it. The timing is such that the ball beats the mid off fielder and has enough to trickle away to the fence. Iqbal has started off well here.

FOUR! Not the ideal line from Kumara. Bowls it on a length and strays on the pads. All Iqbal has to do is get some bat to that and he does. The ball goes well past the keeper and to the fine leg fence for another boundary.

FOUR! A double bluff and it almost worked. The short leg fielder was brought in for Tamim and that sowed the seeds of doubt in his mind. He stands back expecting a short delivery and gets a full one just outside off. He goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge past the diving second slip fielder and it races away to the third man fence for the first boundary in this innings.
Forward short leg in place.
Kayes is off the mark straightaway. On the pads, worked away to fine leg for one.
Lahiru Kumara to run in from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place.
Fuller outside off, Iqbal plays inside the line and lets it go. Decent start for both the sides.
Full on off, pushed down the ground to mid off.
Lovely shot. The channel is just outside off, Tamim hangs back and punches it through covers. Gets another brace.
First runs on the board. Full and on the pads, Tamim whips it away just past the backward square leg fielder. Good running by the openers and they manage to come back for two.
Length ball in line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
Lakmal starts off with a full length ball just outside off, Iqbal strides forward and blocks it towards the bowler.
We are all set to get underway. Tamim Iqbal is all ready to face the first delivery from Suranga Lakmal. Imrul Kayes waits at the other end. Here we go...

Dinesh Chandimal, the away skipper, says that the ODI series was a good one and would look to build on that although the format is different. Is aware of his side doing well in Tests in the past couple of series and would look to take inspiration and put in good performances. Reckons that the track is a dry one and they are going with 6 batters and 5 bowlers.

Mahmudullah, the home side skipper, reckons that the track looks good for batting and then it will spin later, that's why the decision to bat first. States that Shakib has been a gun player for them but he is hopeful of that they will turn up well without him. Opines that they would look to take inspiration from their previous good performances. Adds that Tamim Iqbal and Mushfiqur Rahim are their key players. Ends saying that Sunzamul Islam is making his Test debut for them.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says that it is a typical wicket at Chittagong, being very dry with a tinge of green. Observes that there are a lot of left-handers in the Lankan side and the left arm spinners should get purchase outside the off stump. Reckons that batting first and putting runs on the board should be the aim of the side winning the toss.
TOSS - Mahmudullah calls it right at the toss and BANGLADESH WILL BAT FIRST. Sunzamul Islam makes his Test debut for the hosts.

When two subcontinental teams clash in the subcontinent, it is hard to not expect a turning track. With a plethora of spinners in both teams, one knows on what lines the thinking has been. Shakib Al Hasan is set to miss is first game immediately after being appointed as the full time Test captain of Bangladesh. Mahmudullah will lead the side in his absence. For Sri Lanka, the selected players have been in and around the side and there should be no dearth of experience. Be here as we will let you know the playing XIs in a while.

In a multi-hero film, both the characters have a more or less equal role. Rarely do you see one character being greater than the other. Now shift your attention to the contest on our hands - the first five-day journey between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka at Chittagong - it is hard to say with conviction that one of these teams holds the edge. Both the sides start on an even keel and this should be a lovely game with ebbs and flows.
